events.heading: IDEATHON 6.0
events.summary: The Faculty of Commerce and Management is organizing IDEATHON 6.0 - A Business Plan Competition 2026 for Category A – School Students (Classes IX–XII) and Category B – College/University Students (UG, PG & Research Scholars).

events.heading: Toppers Felicitation Ceremony 5.0
events.summary: Kalinga University, Naya Raipur, is organising the “Toppers Felicitation Ceremony 5.0” on 23 May 2026 to honour outstanding Class 12 CGBSE students, including CG Top 10 Rankers and students scoring 80% and above.

events.heading: Aarambh-2025 – Induction Program for B.Ed Students
events.summary: Our Faculty of Education welcomed newly enrolled students of the Bachelor of Education at Aarambh-2025 – Induction Program.

events.heading: One-Day Workshop
events.summary: The Central Library and Research Department of Kalinga University, in collaboration with Elsevier, organised a one-day workshop held in two different sessions.

events.heading: Legal Aid Cell Commemorates the 76th Year of the Indian Constitution
events.summary: To honour the spirit and values of the Indian Constitution, we celebrated the 76th Year of the Indian Constitution, which highlighted, i.e., justice, equality, liberty, and dignity.

events.heading: Kalinga University Unveils the ‘Dr. Yashwant Singh Parmar Legacy’ Special Collection
events.summary: With an aim to strengthen legal education, the Central Library of Kalinga University conducted the inauguration of the “Dr. Yashwant Singh Parmar Legacy”.

events.heading: Global Conference 2025
events.summary: The Global Conference featured four technical sessions with eminent speakers and over 20 participants in each session.

events.heading: Guest Lecture on IPR for Innovators and Entrepreneurs
events.summary: To address the importance of IPR in innovation and research to young scientists and entrepreneurs, an impactful guest lecture was organised by the Faculty of Science.

events.heading: International Conference SCISUSTAIN 2025
events.summary: The Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology organised a two-day international conference, which saw an active participation of speakers and researchers from India and abroad.

events.heading: Blood Donation Camp 2025
events.summary: In collaboration with the Good Hope Blood Centre, our Pharma club successfully organised a Blood Donation Camp aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDG).

events.heading: International Conference (ICSTDTSD 2025)
events.summary: The Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology organised a two-day international conference, which saw an active participation of speakers and researchers from India and abroad.

events.heading: World Pharmacists’ Day Celebration
events.summary: We celebrated World Pharmacists Day, recognising its important role in healthcare and treatment of diseases.

events.heading: World Ozone Day 2025
events.summary: To spread awareness about the importance of protecting the ozone layer, the Green Club and Department of Zoology organised a painting competition on World Ozone Day for students.

events.heading: Grand Book Fair 2025
events.summary: Our Central Library organised a two-day book Fair as part of the instructions received from the Department of Higher Education to organise special programs in celebration of the 25 years of Chhattisgarh Statehood.

events.heading: National Seminar on Waste Optimization and Sustainable Practices
events.summary: The three-day National Seminar inspired participants to adopt sustainable practices for a cleaner and greener future and even promoted cross-cultural collaboration.

events.heading: Role of Microorganisms in Plants and Human Health
events.summary: The session highlighted the impact of microorganisms on human health and the use of techniques like prebiotics, probiotics, biotechnological applications, antibiotic resistance, natural remedies, and more.

events.heading: Guest Lecture on “Essential Narcotic Drugs
events.summary: The session highlighted the clinical importance of narcotic drugs in pain management and palliative care, and attendees were informed about proper usage and risks associated with misuse.

events.heading: Judex 3.0 Moot Court Competition 2025-26
events.summary: The Judex 3.0 Human Rights Law Moot Court Competition 2025-26 featured Hon’ble Justice Gautam Chourdiya, who shared insights on the role of law in protecting human rights.

events.heading: ICETSD 2025
events.summary: Our Faculty of Technology successfully organised a Two-Day International Conference on “Emerging Technology for Sustainable Development” (ICETSD) 2025.

events.heading: International Conference (ICETSIMD) 2025
events.summary: The Faculty of Information Technology and the IPR Cell organised a Two-Day International Conference on “Emerging Technology for Sustainable Innovation Management and Development”.

events.heading: Public Awareness Program on Groundwater Quality and Monitoring
events.summary: The event was organised to educate our students and local communities about the importance of sustainable groundwater management practices.

events.heading: Emerging Perspectives and Future Trends in Pharmaceuticals
events.summary: Our Faculty of Pharmacy successfully organised a Two-Day DST-SERB/ANRF, Govt. of India Sponsored International Conference to discuss advancements and challenges in the field of pharmaceuticals and allied sciences.

events.heading: Health & Wellness through Ayurveda
events.summary: To raise awareness about Ayurveda, the Office of the Chief Proctor and the Faculty of Pharmacy organised a powerful discussion on “Health & Wellness through Ayurveda”.

events.heading: Kalinga University Clinches Gold at AIU Woodball
events.summary: Among 44 universities of India, our Woodball team secured a Gold Medal in the Mixed Double Event and a Bronze Medal in the Women’s Team Stroke category.

events.heading: Two Days Global Conference On Recent Trends in Law
events.summary: Our Faculty of Law, in collaboration with several prestigious institutions, organised a Two-Day Global Conference which was attended by legal experts, policymakers, and academicians.

events.heading: Hackathon-2025
events.summary: The Faculty of Information Technology successfully conducted the 24-hour KU Hackathon-2025 at its campus, bringing together 26 teams from six different states.

events.heading: Trainers’ Training Certification Course on the POSH Act, 2013
events.summary: The Faculty of Law, in collaboration with the Indian National Bar Association (INBA), organized Trainers’ Training Certification Course” to educate and train participants on the legal and practical aspects of sexual harassment in the workplace.
